# ADR-3082: A07: Prefer centralized identity providers for app portfolio 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Per-app identity multiplies weak configs.

## Decision

Product orgs SHOULD prefer centralized identity providers for app portfolio 10 (A07-10) when reducing password sprawl.

## Consequences

Federation standards are documented.
